corrected_scope.candidate_rule: Enumerate every nonempty natural entry in its original position order with that zero-based position; then every nonempty hidden entry in its order with position+2. Do not collapse equal indices or assume a third natural candidate is a third naturally resolved slot.
corrected_scope.resolver_retained: Index≥2 reads the hidden entry; absent hidden entry falls back to the individual identifier low bit for natural lookup, then natural0 fallback. Stored index is retained; hidden predicate tests that index, not the identity of the resolved ability.
corrected_scope.minimal_vector: Artificial valid inert base-species data: natural [OVERGROW,CHLOROPHYLL,TORRENT], hidden empty. Enumeration returns (OVERGROW,0),(CHLOROPHYLL,1),(TORRENT,2). This is author configuration, not a claim about a bundled default species.
corrected_scope.patch_projection: Ordinary successful confirmation/refresh/messages, non-egg non-Hyper non-ZYGARDE individual initially index0, even identifier, one default PATCH: message names TORRENT, index becomes2, cache is cleared at assignment; resolver returns OVERGROW and hidden predicate is true. Handler returns true; ordinary consumable wrapper deducts one. Final cache emptiness is not promised if a later consumer has already resolved it.
normal_and_boundary_vectors: Only two natural entries and no hidden entries: PATCH has no index2 candidate and returns false, consuming none.
Three natural entries plus first hidden BLAZE: both (TORRENT,2) and (BLAZE,2) remain in that order; PATCH uses the latter name and resolves BLAZE.

Possible-ability debug lists every pair; every index≥2 gets H, selecting a pair writes its index and clears cache, not its displayed identity. CAPSULE still uses only index0/1 and refuses currently hidden-index individuals.
Confirmation cancel, already-hidden index, ZYGARDE, and invalid referenced identities retain their actual separate failure gates; a valid third entry does not bypass them.

corrected_scope.summary: Legal non-egg FURFROU stored1, forced absent, timestamp integer t, nonbattle/nonstorage, first relevant dynamic read at t+432001, valid preceding scene/data/dependencies: opening summary reaches individual sprite lookup, commits stored0 and clears timestamp before resource matching. Cache clear, recomputation and conditional Pokédex registration follow. Recomputation is an operation, not proof every numeric value changes; later display may populate caches again.
corrected_scope.same_value_boundary: Dynamic reading commits only a nonempty result different from stored form. Explicit ordinary and prompt form submissions still execute their commit effects for equal values. Existing WP18/WP21 and FM04/FM40 already cover this distinction; no new mandatory same-value defect.
corrected_scope.bottle_premises: Normal default HOOPA stored0, timestamp absent, forced absent, alive/non-egg/non-Shadow/non-Hyper, no mail (ordinary Item menu available), normal party panel/icon already built and not disposed, nonbattle/nonstorage, default KeyItem bottle inventory1, all resources/messages/data/registration dependencies successful, no plugin/external mutation; prompt and final refresh finish within the three-day window.
bottle_order: The initial dynamic read returns0 equal to stored0; it performs no form submission or timestamp maintenance.
Prompt-type submission writes requested1 and clears ability cache, then begins the callback before its requested-form handler.

Callback refresh resets the same party member panel/icon. Dynamic form read still sees absent timestamp, returns0, and submits0; inner time handler clears the timestamp, then recomputes and conditionally registers.

Callback message completes. The outer handler receives original requested1 and records the current integer time. It does not rewrite form1. Outer recomputation/registration consume the actual stored0 through the species record; they do not certify form1 as seen.

The item handler returns true; ordinary party utility clears annotations, hard-refreshes, and returns true without consuming this KeyItem. The menu refreshes the selected member once more. Fresh timestamp makes further dynamic reads preserve0. Final observation: stored form0, fresh timestamp, bottle1.
normal_and_boundary_vectors: FURFROU at exactly t+432000 does not revert. Battle/storage flags suppress dynamic submission; forced0 returns0 while stored1/t remain. These guards suppress reading-triggered submission, not every explicit form write.
HOOPA stored0 with an already-fresh timestamp: ordinary bottle use retains1 and refreshes the timestamp. Absence of timestamp and presence of fresh timestamp are different inputs.
Direct ordinary submission to1 without a middle dynamic read produces1 with a fresh timestamp. This is a contrast entry, not a replacement for the normal party chain.
After the first bottle result0/fresh-time, another normal use within the window retains1; a subsequent1→0 use clears time. No claim that every use or every form item fails.

Resource failure after a dynamic form read does not imply rollback of an already completed submission; successful final UI/return requires normal dependencies. Real media and host results remain unverified.

corrected_scope.half: Live HP>1 loses floor(current/2); first all reductions, then HP-item checks on still-live field members, then user recharge2/current move. HP1 stays1; all live HP1 locally fails.
corrected_scope.end: Alive user and affected target at after-all-hits: lose round(currentHP/2), minimum1; MagicGuard/RockHead do not block; HP-item check follows.
corrected_scope.damage_registration: Do not reinstate raw M08 no-damage-registration wording: the false argument disables animation, while damage registration retains its default true. Positive reduction sets the two round-damage flags and may set below-half flag at that moment; this does not guarantee every direct-hit record is populated or flags survive later cleanup. M04-003 already states this correctly.
corrected_scope.scope_exclusion: ShadowSky and the separately conditional two-side four-screen clearer are broader M08-only coverage; optional SHADOWSHED unknown binding is M08-003, not an added claim here.
